title: AI and the New Educational Frontier · Why read this book?

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Its central tension connects personalized support with inequality, surveillance, and human judgment.
readerOutcomes: The book follows that tension from early childhood to universities and leadership.
The book asks what personalization should preserve as well as what it changes.
Teachers, relationships, and ethical judgment remain central throughout the argument.
The later philosophical discussion asks what kind of people education should help cultivate.
